name: lululemon athletica
description: lululemon designs technical athletic apparel, footwear and accessories and sells them mostly in its own stores (45 percent of FY2025 sales) and on its own websites (44 percent), with the remainder through other channels (outlets, license and supply partners). Women's apparel is 63 percent of sales. FY2025 revenue was $11.1 billion (+4.9%) but operating income fell 12 percent to $2.2 billion as the Americas shrank (-1%) while China Mainland grew 29 percent at a 40 percent segment margin. The CEO stepped down on 2026-01-31 and interim co-CEOs are running the company during a search.
